name: bandcamp-daily-recs
description: Chrome extension: fresh Bandcamp recommendations every day, based on your own collection.

scripts.check: for f in $(find src -name '*.js'); do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.package: mkdir -p dist && V=$(node -p "require('./manifest.json').version") && rm -f dist/daily-recs-$V.zip && zip -qr dist/daily-recs-$V.zip manifest.json icons src -x '*.DS_Store' && echo dist/daily-recs-$V.zip
